5.subject: Summary of the client meeting
5.body:
Hi John,

Here is a summary of our May 5 meeting. We discussed your requirements for the new project, agreed on the project timeline and key milestones, and reviewed the initial design concepts and your feedback. I’ll update the project plan based on your feedback, and David will coordinate with the development team to begin the initial phase.

The next meeting is to be scheduled for 2024-06-01.

I’ve attached the meeting minutes for reference.

Best,
Emma

- Agreed on the project timeline and key milestones.

Action Items:

- David to coordinate with the development team to start the initial phase.
